profile.summary: The FACES Summer Medical Academy is a two-week summer program for high school students interested in health careers, offered by the FACES for the Future Coalition in Oakland. Students take part in hands-on clinical skills and project-based learning with local health professionals. FACES for the Future is a youth development program that is part of the Public Health Institute.
